selection: First episode from each of the first ten distinct task groups per family in the frozen campaign dev ordering; selected before inference.
sampling: Deterministic uniform sample without replacement from each source-t0 visible/in-bounds and all-frame-valid pool; retain all if fewer than 2048.
loss_normalization: One predicted and one GT mean absolute depth over all nine groups per clip.
alignment: One GT-assisted mean-depth ratio over all nine groups per clip.
